description: `${…}` inside `#{}` is never allowed (ruled S469, scrml-support f487d21): E-CSS-SYNTAX — the cell channel is `@name`.
rationale: §9.1 (S469): `${…}` is never allowed inside a `#{}` block; §65.4.2: dynamic raw CSS is only the quoted `style="…"`; §25.7: a cell reaches CSS through `@name`.
